mod31_epa_play_odd_even_seasons.description: team slope of game pass rate and EPA per play on observed wind (outdoor, 2009-2025, script-controlled WLS), split-half correlation across 32 teams; 4 declared looks (2 outcomes x odd/even seasons and 1000 random game halves)
mod31_epa_play_odd_even_seasons.plain_summary: Whether a team's own drop in passing or offensive EPA per play as wind rises is a stable trait that repeats across halves of its games.
